rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Cantrips (0-Level Spells)
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 戲法

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You prepare the list of artificer spells that are available for you to cast, choosing from the {@filter artificer spell list|spells|class=Artificer}. When you do so, choose a number of artificer spells equal to your Intelligence modifier + half your artificer level, rounded down (minimum of one spell). The spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你需要從{@filter 奇械師法術列表|spells|class=Artificer}中準備你想要施展的法術，你能準備的法術總數等同於 你的智力調整值＋你奇械師職業等級的一半，向下取整（至少1個法術）。不過你能準備的法術必須是已獲得相應環階法術位的法術。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Whenever you finish a long rest, you can touch a nonmagical object and imbue it with one of your artificer infusions, turning it into a magic item. An infusion works on only certain kinds of objects, as specified in the infusion's description. If the item requires attunement, you can attune yourself to it the instant you infuse the item. If you decide to attune to the item later, you must do so using the normal process for attunement (see "{@book Attunement|DMG|7|Attunement}" in chapter 7 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}).
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 每當你完成一個長休後，你都可以觸控一個非魔法的物件，使用奇械師注法來把它變成一個魔法物品。注法只能在注法描述中指定的物品型別上生效。如果該物品需要同調，你可以在為物品進行注法時立刻與其同調。如果你決定以後再與這個物品進行同調，你就必須進行通常的同調程式了（參見"{@book 同調|DMG|7|Attunement}"規則（《{@book 城主指南|DMG}》））。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你能使用此能力的次數等於你的智力調整值（最少1次）。在你完成一次長休後，你恢復所有已被消耗的使用次數。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can now store a spell in an object. Whenever you finish a long rest, you can touch one {@filter simple or martial weapon|items|source=phb|category=basic|type=martial weapon;simple weapon} or one item that you can use as a spellcasting focus, and you store a spell in it, choosing a 1st- or 2nd-level spell from the {@filter artificer spell list|spells|class=Artificer|cast time=action|level=1;2} that requires 1 action to cast (you needn't have it prepared).
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你現在可以在一個物體中儲存一個法術。每當你完成一次長休時，你都能觸控一把{@filter 簡易或軍用武器|items|source=phb|category=basic|type=martial weapon;simple weapon}、或一個你可以將其作為法器使用的物品，你向它之中注入一種法術——從{@filter 奇械師法術列表|spells|class=Artificer|cast time=action|level=1;2}中選擇一個需要一個動作來施展的1環或2環法術（你不需要準備這個法術）。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: {@b Boldness.} The drinker can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to every attack roll and saving throw they make for the next minute. The duration increases when you reach Artificer levels 9 (10 minutes) and 15 (1 hour).
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: {@b 勇氣。} 飲用者可以擲 {@dice 1d4} 並將擲出的數值新增到接下來1分鐘內進行的每次攻擊檢定和豁免檢定中。當你達到奇械師等級9（10分鐘）和15（1小時）時，持續時間增加。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: If the defender has died within the last hour, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to touch it and expend a spell slot. The defender returns to life after 1 minute with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} restored.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 如果防禦者在過去1小時內死亡，你可以使用一個{@action Magic|XPHB|魔法}動作來接觸它並消耗一個法術位。防禦者會在1分鐘後復活，並恢復所有{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: When a map holder would be reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} but not killed outright, that creature can destroy its map. The creature's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} instead change to a number equal to twice your Artificer level, and the creature is teleported to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you or another map holder of its choice.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 當地圖持有者將被減少至0{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}但未被直接殺死時，該生物可以摧毀其地圖。該生物的{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}改為等於你奇械師等級兩倍的數值，且該生物被傳送到你5尺內或另一個它選擇的地圖持有者5尺內的未佔據空間。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can cast {@spell lesser restoration} without expending a spell slot and without preparing the spell, provided you use {@item alchemist's supplies|PHB} as the spellcasting focus. You can do so a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你就可以在不花費法術位、無需準備的情況下施展{@spell lesser restoration||次等復原術}，只要你使用{@item alchemist's supplies|PHB|鍊金工具}作為你的法器。你能夠這麼做的次數等於你的智力調整值（最少1次），當你完成一次長休後，你恢復所有已被消耗的次數。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: The cannon is a magical object. Regardless of size, the cannon has an AC of 18 and a number of hit points equal to five times your artificer level. It is immune to poison damage and psychic damage, and all conditions. If it is forced to make an ability check or a saving throw, treat all its ability scores as 10 (+0). If the {@spell mending} spell is cast on it, it regains {@dice 2d6} hit points. It disappears if it is reduced to 0 hit points or after 1 hour. You can dismiss it early as an action.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 炮臺是魔法物件。不論尺寸，其AC為18，生命值等於你奇械師等級的5倍。它免疫毒素傷害、心靈傷害與所有狀態。若被迫進行屬性檢定或豁免檢定，將其所有屬性值視為10（+0）。若對它施展{@spell mending||修復術}，它恢復{@dice 2d6}生命值。炮臺降至0生命值或存在1小時後便會消失；你也能以一個動作提前使它消失。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: If the {@spell mending} spell is cast on it, it regains {@dice 2d6} hit points. If it has died within the last hour, you can use your {@item smith's tools|PHB} as an action to revive it, provided you are within 5 feet of it and you expend a spell slot of 1st level or higher. The steel defender returns to life after 1 minute with all its hit points restored.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 若對鋼鐵守衛施展{@spell mending||修復術}，它恢復{@dice 2d6}生命值。若它在過去1小時內死亡，且你位於它5尺內，便能以一個動作使用{@item smith's tools|PHB|鐵匠工具}並消耗一個1環或更高環的法術位來復活它。1分鐘後，鋼鐵守衛以全滿生命值復活。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can use this energy a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), but you can do so no more than once on a turn. You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你可以引導奧術能量的次數等同於你的智力調整值（至少1次），但每回合只能這麼做一次。在你完成長休時，恢復所有已被消耗的次數。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You gain 5 temporary hit points for each creature that accepts this feature. Until the rage ends, the chosen creatures can each use the following benefit once on each of their turns: when the creature hits a target with an attack roll and deals damage to it, the creature can roll a {@dice d6} and gain a bonus to the damage equal to the number rolled.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你獲得等同於接受狩獵之喚特性的生物數量五倍點的臨時生命值。直至你的狂暴結束前，被選擇的這些生物可以分別在每個自己的回合中使用一次以下能力：當攻擊檢定命中一個目標並造成傷害時，可以骰一個{@dice d6}，並在傷害中獲得骰出結果的加值。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: At 10th level, you learn to channel divine power to inspire zealotry in others. As a bonus action, you unleash a battle cry infused with divine energy. Up to ten other creatures of your choice within 60 feet of you that can hear you gain advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of your next turn.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 在10級時，你學會了引導神力，讓其他人也被你的狂熱所感染。以一個附贈動作，你憤怒的怒吼並釋放出一道蘊含神聖能量的戰吼。選擇你周圍60尺範圍內至多10個能聽到你吼叫聲的其他生物，直到你的下個回合開始前，他們進行的攻擊檢定與豁免檢定獲得優勢。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: In addition, once per Rage, you can increase the range of that teleport to 150 feet. When you do so, you can also bring up to six willing creatures who are within 10 feet of you. Each creature teleports to an unoccupied space of your choice within 10 feet of your destination space.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 此外，每次狂暴期間僅一次，你可以使傳送的距離提升至 150 尺，並可以選擇帶上至多 6 個位於你 10 尺內的自願生物同你一起傳送。每個其他生物都將被傳送至位於你目的地 10 尺內的你選擇的未佔據空間中。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: A divine entity helps ensure you can continue the fight. You have a pool of four d12s that you can spend to heal yourself. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend dice from the pool, roll them, and regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the roll's total.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 某個神聖實體對你施以援手以確保你總能繼續戰鬥。你獲得一個有著 4 枚d12的治療池，你可以用其中的骰子治癒自身。以一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}，你可以消耗治療池中任意枚骰子來恢復你的{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}。投擲所有你消耗的骰子，將它們相加，即是你以此恢復的生命值。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Choose three {@item Musical Instrument|XPHB|Musical Instruments}
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 任選3件{@item Musical Instrument|XPHB|樂器}

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You know two cantrips of your choice from the bard spell list. You learn additional bard cantrips of your choice at higher levels, learning a 3rd cantrip at 4th level and a 4th at 10th level.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 第1級時，你從詩人法術列表中選擇兩個戲法作為已知法術。在獲得更高詩人等級後你還可以習得其它的戲法，4級時學習第3個戲法，10級時學習第4個。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: The Bard table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your {@filter bard spells|spells|class=bard} of 1st level and higher. To cast one of these spells, you must expend a slot of the spell's level or higher. You regain all expended spell slots when you finish a long rest.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 「吟遊詩人」表顯示你擁有多少法術位，可用來施展一環及更高環階的{@filter 吟遊詩人法術|spells|class=bard}。施展其中一道法術時，你必須消耗一道環階等於或高於該法術環階的法術位。完成一次長休後，你重獲所有已消耗的法術位。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You know four 1st-level spells of your choice from the bard spell list.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 第1級時，你從詩人法術列表中選擇四個1環法術作為已知法術。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Once within the next hour when the creature fails a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, the creature can roll the Bardic Inspiration die and add the number rolled to the {@dice d20}, potentially turning the failure into a success. A Bardic Inspiration die is expended when it's rolled.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 在接下來的 1 小時內，當那名生物在一次{@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 檢定}中失敗時，那名生物可以投擲詩人激勵骰並將擲骰結果附加到該次{@dice d20}中，這可能將失敗變為成功。詩人激勵骰將在投擲時被消耗。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can confer a Bardic Inspiration die a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你可以授予詩人激勵骰的次數等於你的魅力調整值（最低為 1），當你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時，你重獲所有被消耗的使用次數。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You know two cantrips of your choice from the {@filter Bard spell list|spells|class=Bard}. {@spell Dancing Lights|XPHB} and {@spell Vicious Mockery|XPHB} are recommended.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你已知2個你在{@filter 吟遊詩人法術列表|spells|class=Bard}中選擇的吟遊詩人戲法。推薦選擇{@spell Dancing Lights|XPHB|舞光術}和{@spell Vicious Mockery|XPHB|惡言相加}。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Bard levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the Bard Features table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional spells from the {@filter Bard spell list|spells|class=Bard} until the number of spells on your list matches the number on the table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you're a level 3 Bard, your list of prepared spells can include six spells of levels 1 and 2 in any combination.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 已準備法術數量會隨你吟遊詩人等級的提升而增加，如吟遊詩人特性表中的準備法術一列所示。每當這一列的數字增加時，從{@filter 吟遊詩人法術列表|spells|class=Bard}中選擇額外法術準備，直至已準備法術的數量與表格中的數字一致。你必須擁有與準備法術的環階相對應環階的法術位。例如，如果你是一位3級吟遊詩人，則你的準備法術列表能包括六道一環或二環的吟遊詩人法術，隨意組合。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Whenever you give a creature a Bardic Inspiration die, you can utter a note from the Song of Creation to create a Tiny mote of potential, which orbits within 5 feet of that creature. The mote is intangible and invulnerable, and it lasts until the Bardic Inspiration die is lost. The mote looks like a musical note, a star, a flower, or another symbol of art or life that you choose.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 每當你給予一個生物詩人激勵骰時，你可以唱出造物之歌的一個音符，創造一團微小的潛能微塵，在那個生物五尺以內的軌道上環繞。這個微塵是無形且不可被摧毀的，它將在這個詩人激勵骰被消耗掉前一直存在。這團微塵看起來像一個音符，或是一顆星星，一朵花，抑或其他任何一種藝術或者生命的符號，這將由你來決定。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: As an action, you can animate one Large or smaller nonmagical item within 30 feet of you that isn't being worn or carried. The animate item uses the {@creature Dancing Item|TCE} stat block, which uses your proficiency bonus (PB). The item is friendly to you and your companions and obeys your commands. It lives for 1 hour, until it is reduced to 0 hit points, or until you die.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 以一個動作，你可以活化你周圍30尺內的一個你可以看見的、未被裝著或攜帶的大型或者更小的非魔法物品。這件活化的物品將會使用如下{@creature Dancing Item|TCE|舞空物品}的屬性，並且使用你的熟練加值（PB）。這件物品將會對你以及你的夥伴保持友好，而且會聽從你的命令。它將持續保持活性一個小時，如果它生命值降低為0、或你死亡，它也會提前失去活性。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Starting at 6th level, when you cast a bard spell that deals damage or restores hit points through the Spiritual Focus, roll a {@dice d6}, and you gain a bonus to one damage or healing roll of the spell equal to the number rolled.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 從6級開始，當你透過精魂法器施放一個造成傷害或恢復生命的吟遊詩人法術時，投一枚{@dice d6}，你在該法術的一次傷害或治療擲骰中獲得等同於該d6擲骰結果的加值。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Tale of the Renowned Duelist. You make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes force damage equal to two rolls of your Bardic Inspiration die + your Charisma modifier.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 著名決鬥家的故事。你對目標進行一次近戰法術攻擊。若命中，則目標受到等同於2個你的詩人激勵骰的擲骰結果+你的魅力調整值的力場傷害。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Tale of the Beloved Friends. The target and another creature of its choice it can see within 5 feet of it gains temporary hit points equal to a roll of your Bardic Inspiration die + your Charisma modifier.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 摯友們的故事。目標和其所選的另一個在其5尺內且其可見的生物獲得臨時生命值，數值等於1個你的詩人激勵骰的擲骰結果+你的魅力調整值。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Tale of the Avenger. For 1 minute, any creature that hits the target with a melee attack takes force damage equal to a roll of your Bardic Inspiration die.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 復仇者的故事。在1分鐘裡，任何使用近戰攻擊命中目標的生物會受到相當於1個你的詩人激勵骰的擲骰結果的力場傷害。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Tale of the Phantom. The target becomes {@condition invisible} until the end of its next turn or until it hits a creature with an attack. If the target hits a creature with an attack during this invisibility, the creature it hits takes necrotic damage equal to a roll of your Bardic Inspiration die and is {@condition frightened} of the target until the end of the {@condition frightened} creature's next turn.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 鬼魅的故事。目標變為{@condition invisible||隱形}，直到其下一個回合結束，或以攻擊命中一個生物。如果目標在這次隱形期間攻擊命中了一個生物，被攻擊的生物受到暗蝕傷害，數值等同於1個你的詩人激勵骰的擲骰結果，並陷入對目標的{@condition frightened||恐慌}之中，{@condition frightened||恐慌}效果持續到該生物的下一個回合結束。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Tale of the Brute. Each creature of the target's choice it can see within 30 feet of it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes thunder damage equal to three rolls of your Bardic Inspiration die and is knocked {@condition prone}. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw takes half as much damage and isn't knocked {@condition prone}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 兇蠻惡漢的故事。目標所選擇的30尺內其可見的每個生物都必須進行一次力量豁免。若豁免失敗，該生物受到3個你的詩人激勵骰的擲骰結果的雷鳴傷害，並{@condition prone||倒地}。若豁免成功，該生物受到的傷害減半，並且不會{@condition prone||倒地}。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Tale of the Dragon. The target spews fire from the mouth in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking fire damage equal to four rolls of your Bardic Inspiration die on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 巨龍的故事。目標從口中噴出30尺錐形的火焰。在範圍內的每個生物都必須進行一次敏捷豁免，若豁免失敗則受到4個你的詩人激勵骰的擲骰結果的火焰傷害，若豁免則成功傷害減半。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Tale of the Mind-Bender. You evoke an incomprehensible fable from an otherworldly being. The target must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or take psychic damage equal to three rolls of your Bardic Inspiration die and be {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 奪魂故事。你從某個超凡的存在那裡喚起了一則超越人的理解能力的寓言。目標必須成功透過一次智力豁免，否則受到相當於3個你的詩人激勵骰的擲骰結果的心靈傷害，並被{@condition stunned||震懾}直到其下一個回合結束。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: If you perform for at least 1 minute, you can attempt to inspire wonder in your audience by singing, reciting a poem, or dancing. At the end of the performance, choose a number of humanoids within 60 feet of you who watched and listened to all of it, up to a number equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one). Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or be {@condition charmed} by you. While {@condition charmed} in this way, the target idolizes you, it speaks glowingly of you to anyone who talks to it, and it hinders anyone who opposes you, although it avoids violence unless it was already inclined to fight on your behalf. This effect ends on a target after 1 hour, if it takes any damage, if you attack it, or if it witnesses you attacking or damaging any of its allies.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 若你進行了至少1分鐘的表演，你就可以藉由歌唱、吟詩、或舞蹈的方式來讓你的觀眾們感受到奇妙的力量。在這次表演的結束時，選擇你周圍60尺範圍內一定數量的、完整觀看並聆聽了你的表演的類人生物，可以選擇的數量至多等同於你的魅力調整值個（至少1個）。每個目標必須透過一次對抗你的法術豁免DC的感知豁免，若豁免失敗則其將被你{@condition charmed||魅惑}。當被你以此法{@condition charmed||魅惑}時，目標視你為偶像，他會對任何和它交談的人讚頌你，反對任何對抗你的人，它會避免使用暴力，除非他本來就傾向於為你而戰。每個目標身上的效應都將持續1小時。當受影響生物受到任何傷害、你攻擊了它、或它目睹你對任何它的盟友進行攻擊或造成傷害時會提前結束。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: As a bonus action, you can expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration to grant yourself a wondrous appearance. When you do so, choose a number of creatures you can see and that can see you within 60 feet of you, up to a number equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one). Each of them gains 5 temporary hit points. When a creature gains these temporary hit points, it can immediately use its reaction to move up to its speed, without provoking opportunity attacks.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 以一個附贈動作，你可以消耗一次吟遊激勵的次數，讓自己得到華美而出塵的外貌。此時，選擇你周圍60尺內的一定數量能看見你且你也能看見的生物，其數量至多等同於你的魅力調整值個（至少1個）。每個生物都會獲得5點臨時生命值。而當一個生物獲得這些臨時生命值時，它可以用其反應移動至多等同於其速度的距離，此次移動不會引發藉機攻擊。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend a use of your Bardic Inspiration and channel a specific spirit. When you do so, choose the spirit from the Spirits from Beyond table rather than rolling. The chosen spirit's corresponding number must be less than or equal to the highest number on your Bardic Inspiration die; for example, if your Bardic Inspiration die is a {@dice d8}, you can choose to channel any spirit up to (and including) the Shade.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你可以使用附贈動作並消耗一次吟遊詩人激勵的使用次數，以此通靈一位特定的精魂。當你如此做時，你直接從彼岸之魂表上選擇精魂，而無需擲骰。所選精魂的對應序號必須等於或小於你當前吟遊詩人激勵骰的最大面值；例如，如果你的吟遊詩人激勵骰是{@dice d8}，你可以選擇通靈直至幽靈（序號8）在內的任何精魂。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 3+ spell slot (no action required).
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 此特性一經使用，直至完成{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}你都無法再次使用。你也可以消耗一個三環及以上的法術位（無需動作）來重置此特性的使用權。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: The Cleric table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your {@filter cleric spells|spells|class=cleric} of 1st level and higher. To cast one of these spells, you must expend a slot of the spell's level or higher. You regain all expended spell slots when you finish a long rest.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 「牧師」表顯示你擁有多少法術位，可用來施展一環及更高環階的{@filter 牧師法術|spells|class=cleric}。施展其中一道法術時，你必須消耗一道環階等於或高於該法術環階的法術位。完成一次長休後，你重獲所有已消耗的法術位。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Imploring your deity's aid requires you to use your action. Describe the assistance you seek, and roll percentile dice. If you roll a number equal to or lower than your cleric level, your deity intervenes. The DM chooses the nature of the intervention; the effect of any cleric spell or cleric domain spell would be appropriate. If your deity intervenes, you can't use this feature again for 7 days. Otherwise, you can use it again after you finish a long rest.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你需要用一個動作來請求所信仰神的幫助。描述你所需要的幫助，然後擲d100。如果你的結果等於或者小於你的牧師等級，你將得到神的回應。回應的結果由DM作出選擇；此時通常請求任何牧師法術或者領域法術的效應都在可接受範圍內。如果你的神回應了請求，你在此後的7日內無法再次使用該特性；否則你可以在完成長休後再次使用該特性。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You know three cantrips of your choice from the {@filter Cleric spell list|spells|class=Cleric}. {@spell Guidance|XPHB}, {@spell Sacred Flame|XPHB}, and {@spell Thaumaturgy|XPHB} are recommended.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你已知{@filter 牧師法術列表|spells|class=Cleric}中3個你選擇的戲法。推薦選擇{@spell Guidance|XPHB|神導術}，{@spell Sacred Flame|XPHB|聖火術}和{@spell Thaumaturgy|XPHB|奇術}。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You prepare the list of level 1+ spells that are available for you to cast with this feature. To start, choose four level 1 spells from the {@filter Cleric spell list|spells|class=Cleric}. {@spell Bless|XPHB}, {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB}, {@spell Guiding Bolt|XPHB}, and {@spell Shield of Faith|XPHB} are recommended.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你準備了一系列一環或更高的法術，以供此特性施法使用。初始時，從{@filter 牧師法術列表|spells|class=Cleric}選擇4個一環法術。推薦選擇{@spell Bless|XPHB|祝福術}，{@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB|療傷術}，{@spell Guiding Bolt|XPHB|光導箭}和{@spell Shield of Faith|XPHB|虔誠護盾}。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Cleric levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the Cleric Features table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional spells from the {@filter Cleric spell list|spells|class=Cleric} until the number of spells on your list matches the number on the table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you're a level 3 Cleric, your list of prepared spells can include six spells of levels 1 and 2 in any combination.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 當你獲得牧師等級時，你能準備的法術數量也會隨之提升，如同牧師特性表中準備法術一欄所示。每當該數值提升時，從{@filter 牧師法術列表|spells|class=Cleric}中選擇額外的法術直至你準備的法術數量和該數值相等。你選擇的新法術必須是你擁有法術位的法術。例如，作為一個3級牧師，你的準備法術表由6個一環或二環法術組成，可以自由搭配。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you present your {@item Holy Symbol|XPHB} and censure Undead creatures. Each Undead of your choice within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature fails its save, it has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} and {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} conditions for 1 minute. For that duration, it tries to move as far from you as it can on its turns. This effect ends early on the creature if it takes any damage, if you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, or if you die.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 以一個{@action Magic|XPHB|魔法}動作，你展現{@item Holy Symbol|XPHB|聖徽}，斥退諸亡靈生物。你30尺內每個由你選擇的亡靈都必須進行一次感知豁免，失敗則陷入{@condition Frightened|XPHB|恐慌}和{@condition Incapacitated|XPHB|失能}狀態，持續一分鐘。在這段持續時間內，被驅散的生物會儘可能遠離你。此效應在其受到傷害時提前結束，你陷入{@condition Incapacitated|XPHB|失能}狀態或是死亡也會結束此效應。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: As you meditate, you see visions of recent events in your immediate vicinity (a room, street, tunnel, clearing, or the like, up to a 50-foot cube), going back a number of days equal to your Wisdom score. For each minute you meditate, you learn about one significant event, beginning with the most recent. Significant events typically involve powerful emotions, such as battles and betrayals, marriages and murders, births and funerals. However, they might also include more mundane events that are nevertheless important in your current situation.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 冥想時，你會看見所在位置附近近期事件的幻象（例如一個房間、街道、隧道或空地，最大為50尺立方體），並可回溯等同於你感知值的日數。每冥想1分鐘，你便得知一件重大事件，從最近的事件開始。重大事件通常涉及強烈情緒，例如戰鬥與背叛、婚姻與謀殺、出生與葬禮；但也可能包括較為平凡、卻對當前情勢相當重要的事件。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: As an action, you create a perfect illusion of yourself that lasts for 1 minute, or until you lose your {@status concentration} (as if you were {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). The illusion appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within 30 feet of you. As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the illusion up to 30 feet to a space you can see, but it must remain within 120 feet of you.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 作為一個動作，你可以創造一個完美的自身幻象。該幻象持續存在一分鐘，或直至你失去對該特性的{@status concentration||專注}（等同於{@status concentration||專注於}一個法術）。該幻象出現在你身邊30尺內一個你能看見且未被佔據的空間。你在自己回合內可以用一個附贈動作讓該幻象移動至多30尺到某個你能看見的地方，但其必須始終保持離你120尺以內。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: As an action, you create a perfect illusion of yourself that lasts for 1 minute, or until you lose your {@status concentration} (as if you were {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). The illusion appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within 30 feet of you. As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the illusion up to 30 feet to a space you can see, but it must remain within 120 feet of you.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 作為一個動作，你可以創造一個完美的自身幻象。該幻象持續存在一分鐘，或直至你失去對該特性的{@status concentration||專注}（等同於{@status concentration||專注於}一個法術）。該幻象出現在你身邊30尺內一個你能看見且未被佔據的空間。你在自己回合內可以用一個附贈動作讓該幻象移動至多30尺到某個你能看見的地方，但其必須始終保持離你120尺以內。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Starting at 1st level, you can invoke the power of law to drive an ally to attack. If you cast a spell with a spell slot of 1st level or higher and target an ally with the spell, that ally can use their reaction immediately after the spell to make one weapon attack against a creature of your choice that you can see.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 從1級開始，你可以呼叫律法之力來驅使一位盟友進攻。如果你消耗法術位施展了一環或更高環階的法術，且用該法術指定了一位盟友作為目標時，那位盟友可以在法術後立即使用他們的反應來對你指定、且能看見的一名目標進行一次武器攻擊。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You conduct an hour-long ritual that crafts a nonmagical item that must include some metal: a {@filter simple or martial weapon|items|source=phb|category=basic|type=martial weapon;simple weapon}, a suit of armor, ten pieces of ammunition, a set of tools, or another metal object (see chapter 5, "Equipment," in the Player's Handbook for examples of these items). The creation is completed at the end of the hour, coalescing in an unoccupied space of your choice on a surface within 5 feet of you.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你進行一場耗時1小時的儀式，製作一件必須包含部分金屬的非魔法物品：一把{@filter 簡易或軍用武器|items|source=phb|category=basic|type=martial weapon;simple weapon}、一套護甲、十份彈藥、一套工具，或其他金屬物件（這些物品的範例見《玩家手冊》第5章「裝備」）。儀式結束時，造物會在距你5尺內、由你選擇的一處表面上的未被佔據空間中凝聚成形。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你可以使用此特性的次數等同於你的感知調整值次（至少1次），在你完成一次長休後你重獲全部已被消耗的使用次數。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你可以使用此特性的次數等同於你的感知調整值次（至少1次），在你完成一次長休後你重獲全部已被消耗的使用次數。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You gain {@variantrule telepathy|XPHB} out to 60 feet. When you use this {@variantrule telepathy|XPHB}, you can simultaneously contact a number of creatures equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one).
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你獲得60尺{@variantrule telepathy|XPHB|心靈感應}。當你使用此{@variantrule telepathy|XPHB|心靈感應}時，你可以同時聯結數量等同於你感知調整值的生物（最少為1）。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you magically expand your mind to the future. For 1 hour, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests}. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also restore your use of this feature by expending a level 6+ spell slot (no action required).
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 以一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}，你魔法地將思維延展到未來。在1個小時內，你在{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|D20 檢定}上獲得{@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|優勢}。此特性一經使用，直至完成{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}你都無法再次使用。你也可以消耗一個六環及以上的法術位來重置此特性的使用權（無需動作）。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你可以使用此特性的次數等同於你的感知調整值次（至少1次），在你完成一次長休後你重獲全部已被消耗的使用次數。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: When you cast a spell of level 5 or lower from the Necromancy school that targets one creature, or when you cast a spell from the {@book Grave Domain Spells table|RHW|1|Grave Domain Spells}, you can expend a use of Channel Divinity to target a second creature within the spell's range. If the spell requires costly or consumed Material components, you must provide Material components for each target.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 當你施展一道以單一生物為目標的五環或更低的死靈學派法術，或者當你施展來自{@book 墳墓領域法術表格|RHW|1|Grave Domain Spells}中的法術時，你可以消耗一次引導神力的使用次數，在施法距離內指定第二個生物為目標。如果該法術需要有標明價值或被消耗的材料成分，你必須為每個目標提供材料成分。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你可以使用該特性的次數等於你的感知調整值（最少 1 次）。你在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時重獲所有已消耗的使用次數。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you cause yourself to emit an aura of sunlight that lasts for 1 minute or until you dismiss it (no action required). You emit {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 60-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 30 feet. Your enemies in the {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws against your Radiance of the Dawn and any spell that deals Fire or Radiant damage.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 以一個{@action Magic|XPHB|魔法}動作，你可以讓你自己散發出日光組成的靈光，持續一分鐘或直至你將其解除（無需動作）。你散發出半徑 60 尺的{@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB|明亮光照}以及額外 30 尺的{@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB|微光光照}。身處該{@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB|明亮光照}範圍中的敵人，在抵抗你的黎明曙光特性以及任何造成火焰或光耀傷害的法術而進行豁免檢定時具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你可以使用該特性的次數等同於你的感知調整值（最少 1 次）。你在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時重獲所有已消耗的使用次數。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: The Druid table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your {@filter druid spells|spells|class=druid} of 1st level and higher. To cast one of these druid spells, you must expend a slot of the spell's level or higher. You regain all expended spell slots when you finish a long rest.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 「德魯伊」表顯示你擁有多少法術位，可用來施展一環及更高環階的{@filter 德魯伊法術|spells|class=druid}。施展其中一道法術時，你必須消耗一道環階等於或高於該法術環階的法術位。完成一次長休後，你重獲所有已消耗的法術位。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You know two cantrips of your choice from the {@filter Druid spell list|spells|class=Druid}. {@spell Druidcraft|XPHB} and {@spell Produce Flame|XPHB} are recommended.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你習得2個{@filter 德魯伊法術列表|spells|class=Druid}中的戲法。推薦選擇{@spell Druidcraft|XPHB|德魯伊伎倆}和{@spell Produce Flame|XPHB|燃火術}。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Druid levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the Druid Features table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional spells from the {@filter Druid spell list|spells|class=Druid} until the number of spells on your list matches the number on the table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you're a level 3 Druid, your list of prepared spells can include six spells of levels 1 and 2 in any combination.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 已準備法術數量會隨你德魯伊等級的提升而增加，如德魯伊特性表中的準備法術一列所示。每當這一列的數字增加時，從{@filter 德魯伊法術列表|spells|class=Druid}中選擇額外法術準備，直至已準備法術的數量與表格中的數字一致。你必須擁有與準備法術的環階相對應環階的法術位。例如，如果你是一位3級德魯伊，則你的準備法術列表能包括6道一環或二環的德魯伊法術，隨意組合。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: The primal magic that you wield causes you to age more slowly. For every ten years that pass, your body ages only one year.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你行使的原力魔法讓你的衰老速度減緩。每經過 10 年的歲月，你的身體就彷彿只過了 1 年。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You learn one additional druid cantrip of your choice. This cantrip doesn't count against the number of druid cantrips you know.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 在第2級選擇該結社時，你學會一個額外的德魯伊戲法。這個戲法不計入你的已知戲法數量中。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You gain the ability to use Wild Shape on your turn as a bonus action, rather than as an action.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 從你選擇該結社的第2級起，你可以在自己回合內用一個附贈動作而不是動作來使用荒野形態特性。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: If you lose the map, you can perform a 1-hour ceremony to magically create a replacement. This ceremony can be performed during a short or long rest, and it destroys the previous map.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 如果你丟失了星圖，你可以舉行一場為時一小時的儀式來使用魔法創造一個替代品。這一儀式可以在一場短休或長休時舉行，並會摧毀先前的星圖。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: As a bonus action, you can choose one creature you can see within 120 feet of you and spend a number of those dice equal to half your druid level or less. Roll the spent dice and add them together. The target regains a number of hit points equal to the total. The target also gains 1 temporary hit point per die spent.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 以一個附贈動作，你可以選擇一名在你周圍120尺內的可見生物，消耗至多等同於你德魯伊等級一半的d6骰。投擲它們並將它們加起來，目標恢復那些骰值之和的生命值。目標同時也將得到每一枚骰子1點的臨時生命值。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can cast one of the level 1+ spells that you have prepared from your Circle Spells feature without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you do so again.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你可以施展一個你以結社法術特性準備的一環及以上法術，而無須消耗法術位，並且你必須在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}後才能再次這麼做。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: In addition, when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you can choose expended spell slots to recover. The spell slots can have a combined level that is equal to or less than half your Druid level (round up), and none of them can be level 6+. For example, if you're a level 6 Druid, you can recover up to three levels' worth of spell slots. You can recover a level 3 spell slot, a level 2 and a level 1 spell slot, or three level 1 spell slots. Once you recover spell slots with this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 此外，當你完成一次{@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|短休}時，可以選擇恢復已消耗的法術位。這些法術位的環階總和不得超過你德魯伊等級的一半（向上取整），且其中任何法術位都不能是6環或更高環階。例如，若你是6級德魯伊，可以恢復環階總和至多為3的法術位：一個3環法術位、一個2環與一個1環法術位，或三個1環法術位。以此特性恢復法術位後，直到完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}前都無法再次如此做。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: The maximum {@variantrule Challenge Rating|XPHB} for the form equals your Druid level divided by 3 (round down).
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你的荒野變形形態的最大{@variantrule Challenge Rating|XPHB|挑戰等級}現在等於你德魯伊等級的三分之一（向下取整）。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Until you leave the form, your AC equals 13 plus your Wisdom modifier if that total is higher than the Beast's AC.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 只要你仍處於荒野變形形態，如果 13 + 你的感知調整值加起來高於野獸的護甲等級，你的護甲等級等於你 13 + 你的感知調整值。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also regain uses by expending a level 2+ spell slot for each use you want to restore (no action required).
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你可以使用該特性的次數等於你的感知調整值（最少 1 次），並且你在結束一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}後重獲全部已消耗的使用次數。你也能消耗一個二環或更高的法術位來恢復一次使用次數（無需任何動作）。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: When you manifest the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your subsequent turns, you can choose another creature you can see in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or take Cold damage and, if the creature is Large or smaller, be pushed up to 15 feet away from you. To determine this damage, roll a number of d6s equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one die).
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 當你顯現出{@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|光環}時，以及在之後的回合中以一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}，你可以選擇另一個在你{@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|光環}範圍內你可見的生物。該生物必須成功透過一次對抗你的法術豁免DC的體質豁免，否則受到寒冷傷害，如果該生物是大型或更小體型，它會被從你身邊推離至多 15 尺距離。投擲等於你感知調整值數量（最少 1 顆）的d6骰來決定傷害。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: While holding the map, you have the {@spell Guidance|XPHB} and {@spell Guiding Bolt|XPHB} spells prepared, and you can cast {@spell Guiding Bolt|XPHB} without expending a spell slot. You can cast it in that way a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 當你持握這件星圖時，你視作總是準備著{@spell Guidance|XPHB|神導術}和{@spell Guiding Bolt|XPHB|光導箭}這兩個法術，並且你可以施展{@spell Guiding Bolt|XPHB|光導箭}而無需消耗法術位。其次數等同於你的感知調整值（最少 1 次），當你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時，你重獲全部已消耗的使用次數。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: If you lose the map, you can perform a 1-hour ceremony to magically create a replacement. This ceremony can be performed during a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, and it destroys the previous map.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 如果你丟失了星圖，你可以舉行一場為時一小時的儀式來使用魔法創造一個替代品。這一儀式可以在一場{@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|短}或{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時舉行，並會摧毀先前的星圖。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can use this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你可以使用這一{@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|反應}能力的次數等同於你的感知調整值（最少 1 次），在你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}後，你會重獲所有已消耗的使用次數。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你能使用此特性的次數等同於你的體質調整值（至少1次）。在你完成一次長休後，你重獲全部已消耗的使用次數。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你能使用此特性的次數等同於你的體質調整值（至少1次）。在你完成一次長休後，你重獲全部已消耗的使用次數。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Spells Known of 1st-Level and Higher
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 已知一環及以上法術

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: The Spells Known column of the Eldritch Knight Spellcasting table shows when you learn more wizard spells of 1st level or higher. Each of these spells must be an abjuration or evocation spell of your choice, and must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For instance, when you reach 7th level in this class, you can learn one new spell of 1st or 2nd level.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 「奧法騎士施法」表的「已知法術」欄顯示你何時學會更多一環或以上的法師法術。每個法術都必須是你所選擇的防護系或塑能系法術，且其環階必須是你擁有對應法術位的環階。例如，當你在本職業達到第7級時，可以學會一個新的一環或二環法術。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: When you use your Second Wind feature, you can choose up to three creatures within 60 feet of you that are allied with you. Each one regains hit points equal to your fighter level, provided that the creature can see or hear you.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 當你使用你的「回氣」特性時，你可以選擇在你周圍60尺範圍內的對你友好的最多3個生物，他們每個人都將恢復等同於你的戰士等級的生命值。不過他們必須要能看到或聽到你的聲音才能獲得這個好處。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You have learned how to imbue yourself with the might of giants. As a bonus action, you magically gain the following benefits, which last for 1 minute:
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你已經學會了如何使用巨人之力灌注自身。你可以使用一個附贈動作，魔法性地獲得以下能力，持續一分鐘。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses of it when you finish a long rest.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你能夠使用該特性的次數等同於你的體質調整值次（至少1次），當你完成一次長休時，你重獲全部已被消耗的次數。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: When you use your Second Wind to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can choose a number of allies within a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from yourself, up to a number of allies equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one). Each of those allies regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d4} plus your Fighter level. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 當你使用你的回氣特性來回復{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}時，你可以選擇等同於你魅力調整值數量（最少為1）的，在以你自身為源點30尺{@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|光環}區域內的盟友。每個盟友獲得等同於{@dice 1d4}+你的戰士等級的{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}回覆。每當你使用此能力後，直至你完成一次{@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|短}或{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}前無法再次使用。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You learn one language from the language tables in the Player's Handbook or chapter 2 of this book. When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can replace a language learned from this benefit with another language you have heard, seen signed, or read in the past 24 hours.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你從《玩家手冊》或本書第二章的語言表中習得一門語言。每當你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}，你可以用另一種你在過去24小時內聽過、看過或讀過的語言來代替從這個特性中學到的語言。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: When you use your Action Surge, you can choose allies within a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from yourself, up to a number of allies equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one). Each of those allies can immediately take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to use one of the following options.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 當你使用你的動作如潮特性時，你可以選擇等同於你魅力調整值數量（最少為1）的，在以你自身為源點30尺{@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|光環}範圍區域內的盟友。每一個你選擇的盟友都可以立即執行一次{@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|反應}來使用下列選項之一：

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You gain an additional Superiority Die when you reach Fighter levels 7 (five dice total) and 15 (six dice total).
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你的卓越骰在第 7（共 5 枚）和第 15 級（共 6 枚）時各增加一枚。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also restore a use of the feature by expending one Superiority Die (no action required).
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 此特性一經使用，直至完成{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}你都無法再次使用。你也可以消耗 1 粒卓越骰（無需動作）重置此特性的使用權。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: The Eldritch Knight Spellcasting table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 奧法騎士施法表顯示了你可用於施展一環及以上法術的法術位數量。你在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時恢復所有已消耗的法術位。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You learn a ritual that creates a magical bond between yourself and one weapon. You perform the ritual over the course of 1 hour, which can be done during a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}. The weapon must be within your reach throughout the ritual, at the conclusion of which you touch the weapon and forge the bond. The bond fails if another Fighter is bonded to the weapon or if the weapon is a magic item to which someone else is attuned.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你習得一種讓你和你的武器建立魔法聯結的儀式。你執行持續一小時的儀式，且可在{@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|短休}時進行。整個儀式過程中武器必須在你的觸及範圍內，直至儀式結束前，該武器必須一直在你觸手可及的範圍內，以完成聯結。若該武器已與另一名戰士建立聯結，或是一把已被他人同調的魔法物品，儀式則會失敗。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can shield yourself and others with telekinetic force. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can choose creatures, including yourself, within 30 feet of yourself, up to a number of creatures equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one creature). Each of the chosen creatures has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover} for 1 minute or until you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你可以使用念力庇護你自己和其他人。以一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}，包括你在內，你可以選擇數名位於你 30 尺範圍內的生物，其數量等同於你的智力調整值（最少 1 名）。每名被選中的生物將在 1 分鐘內視為處於{@variantrule Cover|XPHB|半身掩護}中，該保護將會在你陷入{@condition Incapacitated|XPHB|失能}狀態時提前結束。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: When you expend a Focus Point, it is unavailable until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, at the end of which you regain all your expended points.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 每當你消耗 1 點功力時，直到你完成一次{@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|短}或者{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}前其將暫時不可以再被使用。在完成休息時，你將重獲所有已消耗的功力。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: If you reduce the damage to 0, you can expend 1 Focus Point to redirect some of the attack's force. If you do so, choose a creature you can see within 5 feet of yourself if the attack was a melee attack or a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself that isn't behind {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} if the attack was a ranged attack. That creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take damage equal to two rolls of your Martial Arts die plus your Dexterity modifier. The damage is the same type dealt by the attack.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 若被撥擋攻擊的傷害減少至 0，則你可以消耗 1 點功力將此次攻擊的部分傷害重新定向。如果是近戰攻擊，選擇你周圍 5 尺內的一個你可見的生物；如果是遠端攻擊，選擇 60 尺內一個不位於{@variantrule Cover|XPHB|全身掩護}後的你可見的生物。該生物必須成功透過一次敏捷豁免，否則受到相當於你 2 個武藝骰 + 你的敏捷調整值的傷害。其傷害型別與原先攻擊的傷害型別相同。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Once you reach 5th level in this class, you can spend additional ki points to increase the level of an elemental discipline spell that you cast, provided that the spell has an enhanced effect at a higher level, as {@spell burning hands} does. The spell's level increases by 1 for each additional ki point you spend. For example, if you are a 5th-level monk and use Sweeping Cinder Strike to cast {@spell burning hands}, you can spend 3 ki points to cast it as a 2nd-level spell (the discipline's base cost of 2 ki points plus 1).
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 第5級起，你可以透過消耗額外的氣來提升以法門施展法術的環階，使得法術更具威力。每額外消耗1點氣，法術環階就提升1級。例如，作為一名5級武僧，你透過飛炎擊法門來施展法術{@spell burning hands||燃燒之手}。則此時你可以消耗3點氣來施展2環的{@spell burning hands||燃燒之手}（該法門的基本消耗2加上額外消耗1）。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Each creature in the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes damage of the chosen type equal to three rolls of your Martial Arts die. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|球狀}區域內的每個生物必須成功透過進行一次敏捷豁免。若失敗，該生物受到相當於你 3 個武藝骰的傷害，其傷害型別為你之前所選擇的型別。若成功，則受到一半傷害。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你可以使用該特性的次數等同於你的感知調整值（最少 1 次）。你在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時重獲所有已消耗的使用次數。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You also learn of any events that have occurred within 20 feet of the object within the past hour. The events you perceive unfold from the object's perspective. You see and hear such events as if you were there, but can't use other senses.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你還會知曉該物件20尺範圍內過去1小時內發生的任何事件。你感知到的事件會從該物件的視角展開。你如同親臨現場般看見和聽見這些事件，但無法使用其他感官。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Starting at 3rd level, when a creature's resistance reduces the damage dealt by a psionic discipline of yours, you can spend 1 psi point to cause that use of the discipline to ignore the creature's resistance. You can't spend this point if doing so would increase the discipline's cost above your psi limit.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 從3級開始，當一個生物的抗性降低了你一項靈術所造成的傷害時，你可以消耗1點靈力，使該次靈術忽略該生物的抗性。若這會使靈術的消耗超過你的靈力限制，便不能消耗這1點靈力。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Your blessed touch can heal wounds. You have a pool of healing power that replenishes when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. With that pool, you can restore a total number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to five times your Paladin level.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你的觸碰溢滿祝福，可以醫治傷口。你獲得一個治療能量池，其內的治療能量在每次完成{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}後自動補滿。治療能量池儲備的可恢復{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}總值等於你的聖武士職業等級 ×5。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: The Paladin Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 聖武士特性表顯示了你可用於施展一環及以上法術的法術位數量。當你完成{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時，你重獲所有已消耗的法術位。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You prepare the list of level 1+ spells that are available for you to cast with this feature. To start, choose two {@filter level 1 Paladin spells|spells|class=Paladin|level=1}. {@spell Heroism|XPHB} and {@spell Searing Smite|XPHB} are recommended.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你準備可供你以此特性施展的一環及更高環階的法術列表。最初，選擇兩道{@filter 1環聖武士法術|spells|class=Paladin|level=1}，推薦選擇{@spell Heroism|XPHB|英雄氣概}和{@spell Searing Smite|XPHB|熾焰斬}。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Paladin levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the Paladin Features table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional Paladin spells until the number of spells on your list matches the number in the Paladin Features table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you're a level 5 Paladin, your list of prepared spells can include six Paladin spells of level 1 or 2 in any combination.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 已準備法術數量會隨你聖武士等級的提升而增加，如聖武士特性表中的準備法術一列所示。每當這一列的數字增加時，法術列表中選擇額外法術準備，直至已準備法術的數量與表格中的數字一致。你所選擇法術的環階必須是你所擁有法術位對應的環階。例如，如果你是一名5級的聖武士，則你的準備法術列表能包括六道一環或二環的聖武士法術，隨意組合。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can expend one use of this class's Channel Divinity to overwhelm foes with awe. As you present your {@item Holy Symbol|XPHB} or weapon, you can target a number of creatures equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature) that you can see within 60 feet of yourself. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute or until it takes any damage. While {@condition Frightened|XPHB} in this way, a target can do only one of the following on its turns: move, take an action, or take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 以一個{@action Magic|XPHB|魔法}動作，你消耗一次引導神力使用次數讓敵人被恐懼吞沒。你高舉{@item Holy Symbol|XPHB|聖徽}或武器，選擇位於你 60 尺內，數量至多等於你魅力調整值（最少為 1）的可見生物作為目標。每個目標必須成功透過一次感知豁免，否則陷入{@condition Frightened|XPHB|恐慌}狀態，持續 1 分鐘或直到其受到任何傷害為止。因此陷入{@condition Frightened|XPHB|恐慌}的生物每回合只能執行下列選項之一：移動、執行一個動作或執行一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Using your action, you undergo a transformation. For 1 minute, you gain the following benefits:

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can use your Channel Divinity to invest your presence with the warding power of your faith. As an action, you can choose a number of creatures you can see within 30 feet of you, up to a number equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature). For 1 minute, you and the chosen creatures have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你可以用引導神力，將信仰的守護力量融入你的存在之中。以一個動作，你可以選擇周圍30尺範圍內數個你可見的生物，其數量至多等同於你的魅力調整值（至少1個生物）。接下來1分鐘內，你與所有被你選擇的生物在智力、感知、與魅力豁免上都將具有優勢。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你能使用此特性的次數等同於你的魅力調整值（最少 1 次），你在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}後重獲所有消耗的次數。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you gain the benefits below for 10 minutes or until you end them (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required).
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 以一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}，你可獲得下列的增益。持續 10 分鐘，你也可以令其提前終止（無需動作）。此特性一經使用，直至完成{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}你都無法再次使用。你也可以消耗一個五環法術位（無需動作）重置此特性的使用權。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: When you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and not killed outright, you can drop to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} instead, and you regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to three times your Paladin level. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 當你{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}降至 0，但尚未被直接殺死時，可以選擇讓你的{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}降到 1 而不是 0，然後你再恢復相當於你聖武士等級三倍的{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}。該能力一經使用，直至完成{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}你都無法再次使用。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can imbue your Aura of Protection with primal power, granting the benefits below for 1 minute or until you end them (no action required). rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 以一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}，你可以用原初力量強化守護靈光，獲得下列增益，持續1分鐘或直到你終止它們為止（無需動作）。此特性一經使用，直到完成{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}前都無法再次使用；你也可以消耗一個五環法術位恢復此特性的使用次數（無需動作）。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can imbue your Aura of Protection with holy power, granting the benefits below for 10 minutes or until you end them (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required).
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 以一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}，你可以用聖力盈滿你的守護靈光，靈光獲得下列的增益，持續 10 分鐘或直到你將之提前結束（無需動作）。此特性一經使用，直至完成{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}你都無法再次使用。你也可以消耗一個五環法術位（無需動作）重置此特性的使用權。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can empower yourself with the legends—whether true or exaggerated—of your great deeds. rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You are an unsurpassed explorer and survivor, both in the wilderness and in dealing with others on your travels. You gain the Canny benefit below, and you gain an additional benefit below when you reach 6th level and 10th level in this class.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你是一個無與倫比的探險家和求生專家。你在1級時獲得對應的特性，然後在第6級和第10級時再各獲得對應的特性。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can call on your mystical bond with nature to mark the target as your favored enemy for 1 minute or until you lose your {@status concentration} (as if you were {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell).
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 當你以一次攻擊擲骰命中一個生物時，你可以呼喚你與自然的神秘羈連以將目標標記為你的夙敵，持續一分鐘或直到你失去{@status concentration||專注}(如同你在{@status concentration||專注於}一道法術)。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: The Ranger Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 遊俠特性表顯示了你可用於施展一環及以上法術的法術位數量。當你完成{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時，你重獲所有已消耗的法術位。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You prepare the list of level 1+ spells that are available for you to cast with this feature. To start, choose two {@filter level 1 Ranger spells|spells|class=Ranger|level=1}. {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB} and {@spell Ensnaring Strike|XPHB} are recommended.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你準備可供你以此特性施展的一環及更高環階的法術列表。最初，選擇兩道{@filter 1環遊俠法術|spells|class=Ranger|level=1}。推薦選擇{@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB|療傷術}和{@spell Ensnaring Strike|XPHB|誘捕打擊}。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Ranger levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the Ranger Features table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional Ranger spells until the number of spells on your list matches the number in the Ranger Features table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you're a level 5 Ranger, your list of prepared spells can include six Ranger spells of level 1 or 2 in any combination.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 已準備法術數量會隨你遊俠等級的提升而增加，如遊俠特性表中的準備法術一列所示。每當這一列的數字增加時，從遊俠法術列表中選擇額外法術準備，直至已準備法術的數量與表格中的數字一致。你所選擇法術的環階必須是你所擁有法術位對應的環階。例如，如果你是一名5級遊俠，則你的準備法術列表能包括六道一環或二環的遊俠法術，隨意組合。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Your training with weapons allows you to use the {@variantrule weapon mastery properties|XPHB|mastery properties} of two kinds of {@filter weapons|items|type=simple weapon;martial weapon} of your choice with which you have proficiency, such as {@item Longbow|XPHB|Longbows} and {@item Shortsword|XPHB|Shortswords}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你對武器的訓練使你能夠自選並使用2種已熟練{@filter 武器|items|type=simple weapon;martial weapon}的{@variantrule weapon mastery properties|XPHB|精通詞條}，例如{@item Longbow|XPHB|長弓}和{@item Shortsword|XPHB|短劍}。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can give yourself a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d8} plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1). rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 如果野獸死亡不超過一小時，你能使用你的動作觸碰它，並消耗一個一環或更高的法術位使它復活。它會在一分鐘後死而復生並獲得所有生命值。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: In addition, whenever you or a creature you can see within 120 feet of you succeeds on a saving throw against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}, you can use your reaction to force a different creature you can see within 120 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a successful save.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 此外，當你或周圍120尺內你可見的一個生物成功透過了一次對抗{@condition charmed||魅惑}或{@condition frightened||恐慌}的豁免檢定時，你可以用你的反應迫使120尺內的另一個你可見的不同生物透過一次感知豁免，豁免DC等同於你的法術豁免DC。若其豁免失敗，則目標被你{@condition charmed||魅惑}，或對你{@condition frightened||恐慌}（由你選擇），持續一分鐘。目標能夠在他的每回合結束時重複這次豁免，豁免成功時效果提前終止。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: In addition, whenever you cast {@i misty step}, you can bring along one willing creature you can see within 5 feet of you. That creature teleports to an unoccupied space of your choice within 5 feet of your destination space.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 另外，每當你施展{@i 迷蹤步}時，你可以攜帶一個五尺以內你可見的自願生物與你一同傳送。那個生物會被傳送到由你選擇的，位於你的目標位置周圍五尺範圍內的一處未被佔據的空間內。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: A Swarmkeeper's swarm and spells are reflections of the character's bond with nature spirits. Take the opportunity to describe the swarm and the ranger's magic in play. For example, when your ranger casts gaseous form, they might appear to melt into the swarm, instead of a cloud of mist, or the {@spell arcane eye} spell could create an extension of your swarm that spies for you. Such descriptions don't change the effects of spells, but they are an exciting opportunity to explore your character's narrative through their class abilities. For more guidance on customizing spells, see the "Personalizing Spells" section in chapter 3.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 一位叢集守衛的叢集和法術反應了角色與自然精魂的聯絡。在遊戲中，多抓住機會來描述你自己的叢集和遊俠法術。比方說，當你的遊俠施展氣化形體時，施法物件可能會消失在他自己的叢集中，而非變為一團霧氣，而{@spell arcane eye||秘法眼}則可以創造出一部分分離的叢集為你進行偵查。這樣的描述不會改變法術的效應，但它們能讓透過特性描述自己的角色更加引人入勝。需要更多個性化法術的指導，請見第三章中的"定製法術"一節。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: See the "Planar Travel" section in chapter 2 of the Dungeon Master's Guide for examples of planar portals.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 詳見《地下城主指南》第二章的"位面旅行"章節，以瞭解位面傳送門的範例。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Your experience surviving harrowing environments allows you to bolster your allies in addition to yourself. Each chosen creature regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d10} plus your Ranger level and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 hour.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你在酷烈環境中生存的經驗不僅足夠支撐你自己，也能幫助你的盟友。以一個{@action Magic|XPHB|魔法}動作，你可以選擇等同於你感知調整值（至少1個）數量的可見生物。所選的生物能夠恢復等同於 {@dice 1d10}+你的遊俠等級點的{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}，且接下來的1小時內，其為避免或結束{@condition Frightened|XPHB|恐慌}狀態所進行的豁免具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你可以使用該特性的次數等同於你的感知調整值（最少 1 次）。你在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時重獲所有已消耗的使用次數。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: If you're reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} but not killed outright while transformed using Wrath of the Wild, you can surge with wild power. Your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} instead change to a number equal to twice your Ranger level. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also expend a level 4+ spell slot (no action required) to restore your use of this feature.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 當你處於荒野之怒變身下，且生命值被降至0但未被立即殺死時，你可以使狂野之力噴薄而出。你的生命值改為變成等同於你遊俠等級兩倍的數值。該特性一經使用，則直至你完成一次長休前，都無法再次使用。你也可以消耗一枚四環或更高環階的法術位來恢復該特性的使用次數（無需動作）。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: If the beast has died within the last hour, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to touch it and expend a spell slot. The beast returns to life after 1 minute with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} restored.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 如果野獸在過去1小時內死亡，你可以執行一個{@action Magic|XPHB|魔法}動作觸碰它，並消耗一個法術位。1分鐘後，野獸復活並恢復所有{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can cast {@spell Misty Step|XPHB} without expending a spell slot. You can do so a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: The Spells Known column of the Arcane Trickster Spellcasting table shows when you learn more wizard spells of 1st level or higher. rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 表格"詭術師施法能力"中"已知法術"一欄記錄了你獲得更多已知法術時的相應等級。你只能選擇惑控系或幻術系法術，且所獲得法術的環階不能超過你所擁有的最高法術位環階。例如，如果你在本職業達到第7級，則可以學習一個新的1環法術或2環法術。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: As a bonus action, you manifest one of your Psychic Blades, expend one Psionic Energy die and roll it, and throw the blade at an unoccupied space you can see, up to a number of feet away equal to 10 times the number rolled. You then teleport to that space, and the blade vanishes.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 以一個附贈動作，你塑造一把心靈之刃，消耗並投擲一枚靈能骰，將心靈之刃投擲到至多距離靈能骰結果數字十倍尺數的一處可見的未被佔據的空間內。你傳送到目標位置，同時那把心靈之刃將消失。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can sweep your Psychic Blades directly through a creature's mind. When you use your Psychic Blades to deal Sneak Attack damage to a creature, you can force that target to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier). If the save fails, the target is {@condition stunned} for 1 minute. The {@condition stunned} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你能讓你的念刃直接切削一個生物的心智。當你使用心靈之刃對一個生物造成偷襲攻擊傷害時，你能迫使其進行一次感知豁免（DC=8+你的熟練加值+你的敏捷調整值）。若豁免失敗，目標將在陷入長達一分鐘的{@condition stunned||震懾}。被{@condition stunned||震懾}的目標可以在他的回合結束時重複豁免，如果成功這一效應將結束。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Dexterity modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你可以使用此特性的次數等同於你的敏捷調整值（至少1次），當你完成一次長休後你重獲所有已消耗的使用次數。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: The Arcane Trickster Spellcasting table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended spell slots when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 詭術師施法表顯示了你可用於施展一環及以上法術的法術位數量。當你完成{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時，你重獲所有已消耗的法術位。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Prepared Spells of 1st+ Level
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 一環及以上的準備法術

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You prepare the list of level 1+ spells that are available for you to cast with this feature. To start, choose three level 1 Wizard spells. {@spell Charm Person|XPHB}, {@spell Disguise Self|XPHB}, and {@spell Fog Cloud|XPHB} are recommended.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你準備可供你以此特性施展的一環及更高環階的法術列表。最初，選擇三道一環法師法術。推薦選擇{@spell Charm Person|XPHB|魅惑類人}、{@spell Disguise Self|XPHB|易容術}和{@spell Fog Cloud|XPHB|雲霧術}。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Rogue levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the Arcane Trickster Spellcasting table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional Wizard spells until the number of spells on your list matches the number in the Arcane Trickster Spellcasting table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you're a level 7 Rogue, your list of prepared spells can include five Wizard spells of level 1 or 2 in any combination.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 已準備法術數量會隨遊蕩者等級提升而增加，如詭術師施法表的已準備法術欄所示。每當該數字增加時，從法師法術列表選擇額外法術，直到列表中的法術數量與表格一致；所選法術的環階必須是你擁有相應法術位的環階。例如，7級遊蕩者的準備法術列表可以任意組合五道一環或二環法師法術。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Immediately after a creature casts a spell that targets you or includes you in its area of effect, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to force the creature to make an Intelligence saving throw. The DC equals your spell save DC. On a failed save, you negate the spell's effect against you, and you steal the knowledge of the spell if it is at least level 1 and of a level you can cast (it doesn't need to be a Wizard spell). For the next 8 hours, you have the spell prepared. The creature can't cast it until the 8 hours have passed.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 一個生物施展以你為目標、或將你包含在效應區域內的法術後，你可以立即執行一個{@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|反應}，迫使該生物進行一次智力豁免；DC等於你的法術豁免DC。豁免失敗時，你對自己抵銷該法術的效應；若該法術至少為一環，且其環階不高於你能施展的法術環階，你也竊取該法術的知識（不必是法師法術）。接下來8小時內，你準備著該法術，且原施法者在這8小時結束前無法施展它。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can unerringly mimic another person's speech, handwriting, or both if you have spent at least 1 hour studying them.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 在你至少花費了一小時的時間來進行鑽研後，你能夠精準無誤的模仿其他人的言語、筆跡或同時模仿以上兩項內容。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} isn't reduced to 0 by using Steady Aim.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你使用穩定瞄準特性時{@variantrule Speed|XPHB|速度}不會歸零。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you manifest a {@item Psychic Blade|XPHB}, expend one Psionic Energy Die and roll it, and throw the blade at an unoccupied space you can see up to a number of feet away equal to 10 times the number rolled. You then teleport to that space, and the blade vanishes.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 以一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}，你塑造一把{@item Psychic Blade|XPHB|心靈之刃}，消耗並投擲一枚靈能骰，將心靈之刃投擲到至多距離靈能骰結果數字十倍尺數的一處可見的未佔據空間內。你傳送到目標位置，同時那把心靈之刃將消失。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can use any {@item Spell Scroll|XDMG}, using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability for the spell. If the spell is a cantrip or a level 1 spell, you can cast it reliably. If the scroll contains a higher-level spell, you must first succeed on an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana|XPHB}) check ({@dc 10} plus the spell's level). On a successful check, you cast the spell from the scroll. On a failed check, the scroll disintegrates.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你可以使用任何{@item Spell Scroll|XDMG|法術卷軸}，並以智力作為你施展那個法術的施法關鍵屬性。你可以穩定使用戲法或是一環的法術卷軸。如果這個法術卷軸記載了更高等級的法術，你必須透過一次成功的智力（{@skill Arcana|XPHB|奧秘}）檢定（{@dc 10} + 該法術的等級）。檢定成功時，你能夠使用卷軸施展該法術。如果失敗，卷軸化為塵埃。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: In addition, the sidekick gains proficiency in five skills of your choice, and it gains proficiency with light armor. If it is a humanoid or has a {@filter simple or martial weapon|items|source=phb|category=basic|type=martial weapon;simple weapon} in its stat block, it also gains proficiency with all simple weapons and with two tools of your choice.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 此外，協力者獲得5項你所選技能的熟練，並且它獲得輕甲熟練。如果它是一個類人生物或在其資料版中具有一項{@filter 簡易或軍用武器|items|source=phb|category=basic|type=martial weapon;simple weapon}，它也會獲得所有簡易武器和兩種你所選擇工具的熟練。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: In addition, the sidekick gains proficiency in two skills of your choice from the following list: {@skill Arcana}, {@skill History}, {@skill Insight}, {@skill Investigation}, {@skill Medicine}, {@skill Performance}, {@skill Persuasion}, and {@skill Religion}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 此外，協力者獲得以下中2項你選技能的熟練：{@skill Arcana||奧秘}，{@skill History||歷史}, {@skill Insight||洞悉}，{@skill Investigation||調查}，{@skill Medicine||醫藥}，{@skill Performance||表演}，{@skill Persuasion||遊說}和{@skill Religion||宗教}。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: The Cantrips Known and Spells Known columns of the Spellcaster table show when the sidekick learns more spells of your choice. Each of the spells in the Spells Known column must be of a level for which the sidekick has spell slots, as shown on the table. For instance, when the sidekick reaches 5th level in this class, it can learn one new spell of 1st or 2nd level.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 施法者表格的已知戲法和已知法術欄顯示了協力者何時能習得由你選擇的新法術。已知法術欄中的每個法術必須是協力者具有表中所示相應環階的法術。例如，當協力者達到5級時，它能學習1個新的1環或2環法術。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: In addition, the sidekick gains proficiency in two skills of your choice from the following list: {@skill Acrobatics}, {@skill Animal Handling}, {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Intimidation}, {@skill Nature}, {@skill Perception}, and {@skill Survival}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 此外，協力者獲得以下中2項你選技能的熟練：{@skill Acrobatics||特技}，{@skill Animal Handling||馴獸}，{@skill Athletics||運動}，{@skill Intimidation||威嚇}，{@skill Nature||自然}，{@skill Perception||察覺}和{@skill Survival||求生}。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: The sidekick can attack twice, instead of once, whenever it takes the {@action Attack} action on its turn.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 從6級起，每當協力者在自己的回合執行{@action Attack||攻擊}動作時，可以攻擊兩次而非一次。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: The sidekick can use its Second Wind feature twice between rests.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 協力者可以在休息間使用其回氣特性2次。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You have 2 sorcery points, and you gain one additional point every time you level up, to a maximum of 20 at level 20. You can never have more sorcery points than shown on the table for your level. You regain all spent sorcery points when you finish a long rest.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 開始時，你擁有2個術法點。此後你每提升一個術士等級，都會獲得1個術法點，最多至第20級的20點。你的術法點永遠不能超過表中所列對應你當前等級的數值。而已消耗的術法點則可以透過完成一次長休進行恢復。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: An event in your past left an indelible mark on you, infusing you with simmering magic. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can unleash that magic for 1 minute, during which you gain the following benefits:
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你過去經歷的某件事在你身上留下了不可磨滅的印記，為你注入了難以控制的湧動魔力。以一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}，你可以將魔力釋放而出，持續1分鐘。在這1分鐘期間，你獲得以下增益：

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: The Sorcerer Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 術士特性表顯示了你可用於施展一環及以上法術的法術位數量。當你完成{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時，你重獲所有已消耗的法術位。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You prepare the list of level 1+ spells that are available for you to cast with this feature. To start, choose two level 1 Sorcerer spells. {@spell Burning Hands|XPHB} and {@spell Detect Magic|XPHB} are recommended.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你準備可供你以此特性施展的一環及更高環階的法術列表。最初，選擇兩道一環術士法術。推薦選擇{@spell Burning Hands|XPHB|燃燒之手}和{@spell Detect Magic|XPHB|偵測魔法}。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Sorcerer levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the Sorcerer Features table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional Sorcerer spells until the number of spells on your list matches the number in the Sorcerer Features table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you're a level 3 Sorcerer, your list of prepared spells can include six Sorcerer spells of level 1 or 2 in any combination.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 已準備法術數量會隨你術士等級的提升而增加，如術士特性表中的準備法術一列所示。每當這一列的數字增加時，從術士法術列表中選擇額外法術準備，直至已準備法術的數量與表格中的數字一致。你所選擇法術的環階必須是你所擁有法術位對應的環階。例如，如果你是一位3級術士，則你的準備法術列表能包括六道一環或二環的術士法術，隨意組合。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can transform unexpended Sorcery Points into one spell slot. The Creating Spell Slots table shows the cost of creating a spell slot of a given level, and it lists the minimum Sorcerer level you must be to create a slot. You can create a spell slot no higher than level 5.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 以一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}，你可以將未消耗的術法點轉化為一個法術位。創造法術位表格中展示了創造法術位所需的術法點以及創造它所需的最小術士等級。你無法創造高於五環的法術位。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Because your magic flows from within, you can alter your spells to suit your needs; you gain two Metamagic options of your choice from "{@filter Metamagic Options|optionalfeatures|feature type=MM|source=XPHB}" later in this class's description. You use the chosen options to temporarily modify spells you cast. To use an option, you must spend the number of Sorcery Points that it costs.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 由於你的魔法直接從你體內流向外界，你可以修改你的法術來適應自己的需要。你從超魔法選項中選擇並獲得2個你所選的{@filter 超魔法選項|optionalfeatures|feature type=MM|source=XPHB}。你使用你所選的超魔法來臨時改變你施展的法術。要使用一個超魔法選項，你必須消耗等同於其描述中需求的術法點。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Whenever you gain a Sorcerer level, you can replace one of your Metamagic options with one you don't know. You gain two more options at Sorcerer level 10 and two more at Sorcerer level 17.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 每當你獲得一個術士等級時，你可以將一個已知的超魔法選項替換為一個你尚未知曉的超魔法選項。當你的術士等級達到10級時，你再獲得2個超魔法選項；達到17級時，再獲得2個。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Because your magic flows from within you, you can alter your spells to suit your needs; you gain two Metamagic options of your choice from the "{@filter Metamagic Options|optionalfeatures|feature type=MM|source=XPHB}" section later in this class's description.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 由於你的魔法直接從你體內流向外界，你可以修改你的法術來適應自己的需要。你從{@filter 超魔法選項|optionalfeatures|feature type=MM|source=XPHB}中選擇並獲得2個你所選的超魔法選項。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Because your magic flows from within you, you can alter your spells to suit your needs; you gain two Metamagic options of your choice from the "{@filter Metamagic Options|optionalfeatures|feature type=MM|source=XPHB}" section later in this class's description.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 由於你的魔法直接從你體內流向外界，你可以修改你的法術來適應自己的需要。你從{@filter 超魔法選項|optionalfeatures|feature type=MM|source=XPHB}中選擇並獲得2個你所選的超魔法選項。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Whenever you finish a long rest, you can choose what lunar phase manifests its power through your magic: Full Moon, New Moon, or Crescent Moon. While in the chosen phase, you can cast one 1st-level spell of the associated phase in the Lunar Spells table once without expending a spell slot. Once you cast a spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 每當你完成一次長休時，你可以選擇以你的魔法展現出何種月相的力量：滿月、朔月或新月。你處於選擇的月相中時，可以不消耗法術位地施放一次月之法術表格中對應月相的一個一環法術。一旦你以此法施放了一個法術，你無法在完成一次長休前再如此施法。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can now cast one 1st-level spell from each lunar phase of the Lunar Spells table once without expending a spell slot, provided your current phase is the same as the lunar phase spell. Once you cast a lunar phase spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你現在可以不消耗法術位地施放月之法術表格中每個對應月相的一個一環法術一次，前提是你所處的月相與該法術的月相相同。一旦你以此法施放了一個月相法術，你無法在完成一次長休前再以此施展那個月相法術。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Roll on this table at the start of each of your turns for the next minute, ignoring this result on subsequent rolls.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 下1分鐘內，你在每次自己回合開始時重骰本表，並在後續的擲骰中跳過本結果。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: For the next minute, you can see any {@condition invisible} creature if you have line of sight to it.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 下1分鐘內，你可以看到任何處於你視線範圍內的{@condition invisible||隱形}生物。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: For the next minute, you regain 5 hit points at the start of each of your turns.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 下1分鐘內，你在每次自己回合開始時恢復5點生命值。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Creatures have disadvantage on saving throws against the next spell you cast in the next minute that involves a saving throw.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 下1分鐘內，你施展第一個需要豁免檢定的法術時，其目標生物進行檢定時具有劣勢。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: An eye appears on your forehead for the next minute. During that time, you have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 你的前額長出第三隻眼並持續存在1分鐘。下1分鐘內，你所有依賴視覺進行的感知（{@skill Perception||察覺}）檢定具有優勢。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: For the next minute, all your spells with a casting time of 1 action have a casting time of 1 bonus action.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 在下1分鐘內，你所有的施法時間為1動作的法術施法時間變為1附贈動作。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Maximize the damage of the next damaging spell you cast within the next minute.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 下1分鐘內，你施展下一個傷害性法術時其傷害擲骰取滿值。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: For the next minute, you can teleport up to 20 feet as a bonus action on each of your turns.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 下1分鐘內，你可以在每個自己回合內以一個附贈動作傳送至多20尺。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You can't speak for the next minute. Whenever you try, pink bubbles float out of your mouth.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 下1分鐘內，你無法說話。你一張嘴就會吐出粉色的泡泡。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: A spectral shield hovers near you for the next minute, granting you a +2 bonus to AC and immunity to {@spell magic missile}.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 下1分鐘內，一面鬼靈盾牌保護著你，為你的AC提供 +2加值，並使你免疫{@spell magic missile||魔法飛彈}。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: For the next minute, any flammable object you touch that isn't being worn or carried by another creature bursts into flame.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 下1分鐘內，你接觸的任何未被人著裝或攜帶的可燃物都會被點燃。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: For the next minute, you must shout when you speak.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 下1分鐘內，你說話時只能喊叫。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You gain resistance to all damage for the next minute.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 下1分鐘內，你具有所有型別傷害的抗性。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You glow with bright light in a 30-foot radius for the next minute. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of you is {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 下1分鐘內，你發出30尺半徑的明亮光照。任何在你周邊5尺範圍內結束其回合的生物將陷入{@condition blinded||目盲}，並持續至其下一回合結束。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: Illusory butterflies and flower petals flutter in the air within 10 feet of you for the next minute.
rawVisibleNumberWarnings.localized: 下1分鐘內，你身邊10尺範圍不斷出現虛幻的蝴蝶和花瓣。

rawVisibleNumberWarnings.english: You become {@condition invisible} for the next minute. During that time, other creatures can't hear you. The invisibility ends if you attack or cast a spell.
